acceptanceCriteria.text: The Rust consumer requires and validates the supported deployment `contractId` and `schemaVersion` before projecting Route 2/3/4 intent.
The consumer validates the selected deployment profile and architecture against the supported host/runtime profile before mutation.
Unsupported or unknown contract versions/profiles fail closed with a stable bounded error.
Byte identity remains verified first; compatibility checks do not replace the detached SHA-256 trust boundary.
The implementation does not duplicate the complete TypeScript descriptor schema; it owns only the minimal compatibility envelope and fields it consumes.
Regression tests cover authentic-but-unsupported schema version, contract ID, profile, and architecture values.
The compatible current `mottainai.deployment.v1` descriptor continues to project deterministically.

issue.title: fix(runtime): fail closed on unsupported deployment descriptor compatibility
